# suite-speed notes

Decision to record at merge (B-2330):

| B-2330 | 2026-11-16 | Suite speed (design section 6, target 20 minutes). Cause: checkpoints. `clean_data` TRUNCATEd ~100 tables before every test, giving each table, index and TOAST relation new files that every checkpoint then had to fsync (on this machine a checkpoint's sync took ~4 s on average, minutes under load), and every `DROP DATABASE` waits for a checkpoint. Changes, all in test fixtures: (1) `clean_data` empties the same tables with DELETE as the superuser on the test's own database with `session_replication_role = replica` (not subject to RLS, append-only triggers or FK checks, exactly like TRUNCATE); (2) `tests/app` clones its per-test database outside the run lock (only the template build is serial) and drops it in a background thread on the worker as soon as the test ends, waiting for all drops before the worker ends; (3) the controller's end-of-run cleanup drops leftovers 8 at a time. Every test keeps its own fresh database in `tests/app`; no test, assertion or check changed. Measured `-n 8`: main baseline 1548 s (gates, idle); `tests/build`+`tests/identity` 347 s -> 241 s; full suite 2140 passed in 541 s with another unit's full suite running at the same time. Tried and dropped: deferring all drops to the end of the worker or the run (1752 s and 1963 s: more live files for every checkpoint), `synchronous_commit=off` per clone (no gain). |
